description: The chart, labeled Figure 1, illustrates the average performance and token count of CoUT and its baselines for 4 Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across 4 benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents different methods, namely CoT, CoD, CCOT, and CoUT, while the vertical axes display two metrics: Accuracy (%) on the left and Token Count on the right. The Accuracy axis ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, and the Token Count axis ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. Each method is represented by a pair of bars, with the left bar indicating accuracy and the right bar indicating token count, colored according to a legend that associates each method with a distinct color. The accuracy bars show that CoUT has the highest accuracy at approximately 91%, followed by CCOT at around 88.5%, CoD at about 88.4%, and CoT at roughly 80.9%. The token count bars reveal that CoUT has a token count of approximately 354, CoT has around 534, CCOT has about 676, and CoD has roughly 446. The bars are grouped by method, with no specific sorting order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
